name: Internal ops, support and billing agents
summary: Agents for Track3D staff on the same AI gateway: captures and storage, observability (logs, traces, alerts), database health, cloud billing and, on beta, support triage with customer activity. Also the alert webhooks and daily briefs that run them without a user, and the usage ledger that records every model call.

roles.note: These are not customer roles. Access is by internal email (allowlist or domain). Beta adds a narrower admin allowlist for the ginee-web operations pages. Customer roles are denied.

actions.action: Ask the observability or billing agent
See per-user model usage and cost

nfr.statement: How long model usage records are kept. Today the usage ledger has one permanent row per model call, with no expiry, while SigNoz keeps aggregated token and cost series for about a month.
nfr.open_question: How long must usage and cost records be kept, and is usage billed to customers (DEC-066)?

requirements.title: Staff agents see data across companies and are internal-only
requirements.statement: The captures, observability, database and billing agents run with Track3D staff or service credentials and can see data across all companies, including service logs and traces. They are open only to internal emails, in web chat and over MCP. On beta, the support triage tools that show a customer's email and activity are kept internal the same way. What these agents read is sent to OpenAI like any other assistant answer.

requirements.title: Automated agent runs need a shared secret and post to staff channels
requirements.statement: Alert webhooks and the daily architect, billing and captures briefs run without a signed-in user. Each call must present a configured shared secret, compared in constant time; if no secret is configured the route refuses every call. Results go to the configured Slack or Teams webhooks. By default an alert is posted with an "Investigate" link to the chat, and the model analysis runs only when someone opens it.

requirements.title: Every model call is recorded with user, company, tokens and cost
requirements.statement: Each model call made by an agent writes one permanent usage record with the user, company, project, conversation, agent, model, input and output tokens, and cost, using the price that applied at the time. Per-user usage totals over a date range are available to internal staff only.
